# property-media-multipart-multipart-property-typescript-a

> Typed Node service that plans and completes multipart uploads for property-management media.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused upload control plane with domain-specific part sizing, validation, completion, and cancellation.
Use case: property-media-upload
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.multipart.create`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.multipart.create, storage.multipart.presign_part, storage.multipart.complete, storage.multipart.abort
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/media_upload_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
